goal: Establish and execute CGKN Project Generation Benchmark v1 as an independent evaluation layer without changing the production generation route.
acceptance_criteria: A three-case live pilot is attempted only when Provider readiness permits; Provider quota, TLS, timeout, or availability failures are reported as BLOCKED_PROVIDER rather than project failure.
CASE_01 and CASE_03 non-live dry-runs validate harness isolation, runtime, persistence, scoring, reporting, and blocked handling without claiming a CGKN score.

Independent black-box evidence, exact candidate identity, hard-fail overrides, Provider blocker classification, controlled repair scope, and runnable delivery inspection determine benchmark outcomes without trusting CGKN verdicts.
Ten fixed L1-L5 cases validate against one versioned schema while hidden acceptance remains inaccessible to production generation.
The CLI supports case, level, all, resume, and report-only modes with immutable run identity, version binding, long-term metrics, baseline comparison, and no overwrite of prior case results.
The production tree contains no benchmark case markers or fixture-specific branches and the formal generation, Provider scheduling, evidence, packaging, and delivery contracts are unchanged.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: independent greenfield project-generation quality, recovery, delivery, and efficiency
quality_metrics.target: ten fixed cases report one-shot success, controlled-repair success, category scores, hard failures, runtime, persistence, integration, package usability, Provider/Codex calls, attempts, latency, tokens/cost, job reuse, repair-scope accuracy, and stale-evidence rejection without production contamination
quality_metrics.method: version-bound black-box process, HTTP, browser, persistence, package, candidate-hash, and controlled-fault evaluation with immutable per-run reports and baseline deltas

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.
